== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Jaap]] (selfie, blue polo, glasses; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]), [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt), and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch). The man in the pink shirt is mostly out of frame at the edge.

Competitive sharpie team meet-up at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 1 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 1 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]] (selfie, blue polo, glasses; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 2.jpg]]), [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt), and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch). The man in the pink shirt is mostly out of frame at the edge.
